summary: Teardown wrapper: if the global pointer dword_8AC490 is non-zero, free it through FreeWrapper_7bcf and clear the global to null; otherwise just return the stored value.

operations.description: Load dword_8AC490 into result and branch on it; proceed only while the global pointer is non-null.
Invoke FreeWrapper_7bcf with the stored global pointer dword_8AC490 cast to LPVOID, storing its return value into result.
Set dword_8AC490 to null after the free completes.
Return result, which is the freed wrapper result in the guarded path and the original global value in the early path.
